rewrite400.interpretation: Inference sensitivity ablation only: both G models were trained with rewrite ON. OFF retains all generated current emissions and skips historical writes, while P source/provenance flags follow actual cache coverage. Report full60 and mature40 after startup provenance differences vanish; OFF results do not represent a retrained OFF model. Correlations are observational; paired OFF-minus-ON measures the aggregate closed-loop policy effect, not an isolated P/source/reference causal path. Within-window temporal metrics are diagnostics, never replacements for first-emission metrics.
rewrite400.uncertainty: paired take-cluster bootstrap2000; fixed checkpoints; no training-seed uncertainty
rewrite400.timing_note: Instrumentation and parallel GPU workers; no latency claim from this pass.

error_frequency.protocol: Existing predictions only; fixed400/212takes; score20..79. No new inference/training. Error time-mean is computed separately per clip and joint over6s; error MSE identities and FFT Parseval exact. Percentages describe squared error, not additive MPJPE components or an achievable accuracy bound. Foot decomposition is algebra, not causal attribution.

shape_oracle.protocol: Decoding-only diagnostic on saved C predictions. G and P never run or receive labels. Replace fixed beta0 by GT shape only, hold predicted global rotations and pelvis position fixed. GT shape is an oracle, not an allowed benchmark input or a guaranteed learned-shape gain. Separately verify official GT SMPL-X parameters reproduce official body joints with the uploaded asset.
